title: Shops
description: In-game shops, their stock, refresh timers and currencies.

entries.name: Nomadic Merchant
entries.summary: A daily resource-exchange shop. All exchanges are benchmarked to a fixed par ratio; with no discount an exchange is perfectly even, so the only thing that matters is whether a DISCOUNT (or a special item) is attached. Cheap daily value if cycled through.

details.par_ratio: 50 Wood = 50 Bread (Food) = 10 Stone = 2 Iron. This 50:50:10:2 is the 'par value' the whole exchange system uses; without a discount every exchange is even (the raw numbers like '113 iron for 3,000 wood' are irrelevant — only the discount % matters).

deal_rules.discounted_exchanges: Any % off (20%, 25%, etc.) is genuine free resources — always take if you can afford it.
deal_rules.even_exchanges: 0% off exchanges: still take them, because taking one can REVEAL another (possibly discounted) exchange behind it. Keep cycling.
deal_rules.diamond_exchanges: Exchanges costing diamonds are generally skipped — better deals exist in the VIP shop and better uses for diamonds.

special_items.speed_ups: Occasionally offers construction/training/research speed-ups. Highly valuable — take almost always. Late game the bottleneck is TIME, not raw resources (100M+ food/wood common), so converting excess resources into speed-ups is strong.
special_items.advanced_teleporters: Occasionally offered. Move city anywhere in the kingdom; extremely valuable for Castle Battles, Fortress, Sanctuary events, strategic alliance positioning. VIP shop price: 2,000 gems each, limited to 2/week. Grabbing one here = converting ~40M food/wood into ~2,000-4,000 gems of value. Always grab.

details.refresh: Has a free refresh — use it and keep cycling through until good deals are exhausted (~2-3 min/day).

drawback_unsecured_resources.issue: Resources RECEIVED from an exchange are UNSECURED (vulnerable to raids), even if you paid with secured/protected resources.
matters_when: When you have no shield active
does_not_matter_when: Mid-late game (you likely have excess unsecured resources anyway)
Servers with strong NAPs between alliances
When shielded most of the time
drawback_unsecured_resources.verdict: Minor concern for most players; benefits far outweigh it, especially later.

priority_order: 2. Speed-up exchanges (convert excess resources into time savings).
3. Discounted resource exchanges (20-25% off — free resources, no downside).
4. Even resource exchanges (0% off — take to reveal better deals behind them).
5. Diamond-based exchanges (generally skip unless exceptional value).

open_questions: RESOLVED (policy): auto-claim ALL free shop items. Discounted items (70%/50%/30% off) are left to the player for now — even a good discount may not be worth spending the current balance at that moment.
